subject: Three different friendly pterosaurs grouped in a natural habitat, all smiling triumphantly.

foreground.pterosaur_1: Pteranodon (Ornithocheiroid): Three-quarter view, proud happy smile, large backward-pointing head crest, smooth pelican-like beak, positioned prominently.
foreground.pterosaur_2: Pterodaustro (Specialist): Three-quarter view, cheerful smile, upward-curving lower jaw with fine bristles, soft pycnofiber-coated body, positioned beside Pteranodon.
foreground.pterosaur_3: Quetzalcoatlus (Azhdarchid): Three-quarter view, brave happy smile, towering giraffe-like neck profile, folded leathery wing membranes, in the background looking contented.

composition.background: Open, sunny prehistoric coastal beach with a ground sand-scrape nest containing soft-shelled eggs, distant coastal cliffs and a clear blue sky. Celebratory, light atmosphere.
composition.grouping: Pterosaurs are posed on all fours or perched in a way that conveys happiness and success, looking out at the player.

caption_1.style: Bright sky-blue, thick 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned top-center.

caption_2.style: Shiny gold, bold 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned clearly below 'Ptero Eggs!', possibly with a subtle celebratory sparkle effect. Text is slightly textured, like polished gold.

visual_logic.overall_mood: Celebratory, rewarding, successful. Emphasizes the positive outcome of the game.
visual_logic.color_palette: Bright sunny yellows, vivid coastal teals, warm golden sands, with the sky-blue and gold captions standing out.
